subject: Using plyr to divide one data frame by another by id variable

messages.author: 1e82ea932416652e
messages.subject: Using plyr to divide one data frame by another by id variable
parts:
Hello. I hope someone can help me out with a plyr newbie question.


I'm trying to get a handle on how to use plyr, and I have a problem that seems like a good use, but cannot figure out how to do what I want.

The basic idea is that I have two data frames with the same structure but different data, and I want to divide according to matching row and column names. So for every row where "id" == "aaa," divide each cell in one data frame by the corresponding cell in the other data frame.

A semi-working example:


> temp.1 <- read.table(text = "10 20
+                      20 30
+                      10 30")
> temp.2 <- read.table(text = "2 4
+                      5 3
+                      2 6")
> id.var <- c("aaa", "bbb", "ccc")
> temp.1 <- data.frame(id = id.var, temp.1)
> temp.2 <- data.frame(id = id.var, temp.2)
> names(temp.1) <- c("id", "first", "second")
> names(temp.2) <- c("id", "first", "second")
> temp.1
   id first second
1 aaa    10     20
2 bbb    20     30
3 ccc    10     30
> temp.2
   id first second
1 aaa     2      4
2 bbb     5      3
3 ccc     2      6
> temp.1/temp.2
  id first second
1 NA     5      5
2 NA     4     10
3 NA     5      5
Warning message:
In Ops.factor(left, right) : / not meaningful for factors



In my real data, the columns (first, second,...) will match, but the order of the rows may be different (e.g. temp.2 might be ordered "bbb", "ccc", "aaa"), and it's important to divide the cell corresponding to column "first", row "aaa" in temp.1 by the cell corresponding to column "first," row "aaa" in temp.2.


Thank you, in advance, for help doing this in plyr.


Regards,


Tom
